answer: Bind each session key to a work unit and rotate it on every graded submission. Weight the key by the number of independent paths that confirmed the unit, not by the account holding it. Rotate, never reuse, because a reused key links two accounts in one hop. Expire after 3 idle epochs and charge a fresh bond to reissue. A willow of shared sessions collapses to 1 path, an opal of real work shows 5, and the ocean of new keys costs a bond each.
